configuration.0.title: Snipcode
configuration.clipcode.preText.descripti: Text inserted before the first file in a copy payload.
configuration.clipcode.postText.descript: Text appended after the last file in a copy payload.
configuration.clipcode.addExtraLineBetwe: Insert a blank line between files in a copy payload.
configuration.clipcode.setMaxFileCount.d: Cap the number of files a single copy can include (see fileCountLimit).
configuration.clipcode.fileCountLimit.de: Maximum number of files a single copy may include, when setMaxFileCount is enabled.
configuration.clipcode.maxFileSizeKB.des: Files larger than this size (in KB) are skipped when copying.
configuration.clipcode.showCopyNotificat: Show a notification with character/line/word/token counts after each copy.
configuration.clipcode.useFilters.descri: Apply the include/exclude filter rules below when copying.
configuration.clipcode.useIncludeFilters: When filters are enabled, apply INCLUDE rules from filterRules.
configuration.clipcode.useExcludeFilters: When filters are enabled, apply EXCLUDE rules from filterRules.
configuration.clipcode.filterRules.descr: Path/pattern INCLUDE and EXCLUDE rules used when useFilters is enabled.
configuration.1.title: Git Graph+
configuration.gitGraphPlus.autoRefresh.d: Automatically refresh when repository changes are detected
configuration.gitGraphPlus.locale.descri: UI language (auto = follow VS Code language setting)
configuration.gitGraphPlus.graphSortOrde: Commit sort order in the graph
configuration.gitGraphPlus.branchBadgeBa: Thickness of the colored accent bar on the left of branch badges in the graph
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.push: Default force-push mode preselected in the Push dialog.
Default state of "set upstream" in the Push dialog.
Default state of "push all tags" in the Push dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.pull: Default state of "rebase" in the Pull dialog.
Default state of "stash local changes first" in the Pull dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.fetc: Default state of "fetch all remotes" in the Fetch dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.merg: Default merge mode preselected in the Merge Branch dialog.
Default state of "push after merge" in the Merge Branch dialog.
Default state of "delete source branch after merge" in the Merge Branch dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.reba: Default state of "autostash" in the Rebase dialog.
Default state of "push after rebase" in the Rebase dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.amen: Default state of "keep the previous commit message" in the Amend dialog.
Default state of "reset the commit date" in the Amend dialog.
Default state of "reset the author" in the Amend dialog.
Default state of "amend only, don't add currently staged changes" in the Amend dialog.
Default state of "push after amend" in the Amend dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.chec: Default handling of uncommitted changes preselected in the Checkout dialog.
Default handling of uncommitted changes preselected in the Checkout Remote Branch dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.crea: Default state of "checkout the new branch" in the Create Branch dialog.
Default state of "publish to remote" in the Create Branch dialog.
Default state of "push the tag to remote" in the Create Tag dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.cher: Default state of "don't commit, apply to the working tree only" in the Cherry-pick dialog.
Default state of "push after cherry-pick" in the Cherry-pick dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.reve: Default state of "don't commit, apply to the working tree only" in the Revert dialog.
Default state of "push after revert" in the Revert dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.rese: Default reset mode preselected in the Reset dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.stas: Default state of "include untracked files" in the Stash dialog.
Default state of "keep the index (staged changes)" in the Stash dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.dele: Default state of "force delete" in the Delete Branch dialog.
Default state of "also delete the remote-tracking branch" in the Delete Branch dialog.
Default state of "also delete the tag on remote" in the Delete Tag dialog.
configuration.gitGraphPlus.defaults.remo: Default state of "also delete the worktree's branch" in the Remove Worktree dialog.
